text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Finished sprinting, Espo-sensei! ...How was it!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ngaaah... Nnnngh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't your footwork kinda sloppy?
That's gonna be brutal on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... You gotta do it sharp and clean, with a BAM!
You push off with the soles of your feet like WHAM! Like WHAM!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Umm!!
For example, not that we'd do this in an actual race,
without leaning your body—
"Let's accelerate with my upper body deliberately upright!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Strengthen the kick from above—
........................

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... Kicking power, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...
I got it, dash, dash! Go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okaaay☆
And a few days after the summer training camp began...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...There should be a TV here.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Oh.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bracket 4, Gate 8, Smart Falcon.
She is another one of the Umamusume who successfully
switched from turf to dirt.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
"First, we should focus on aptitudes.
It would be wonderful if her talent blossoms on dirt, but—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Everyooone!!
I'm so, so sooorry for surprising you all
with the sudden change in plans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is... Falco's really nervous.
No matter how much I train,
I'm still so bad at the starts and stuff...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll keep aiming for center!
Please watch over me as I take this step forward with all my might to become a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-Idiot!
Why would you go and say I'm nervous?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Take that back! They'll look down on you!!
Don't make yourself an easy target!!
(KER-CLUNK!!)
(WOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing, Falcon-san!
Getting 2nd place in your very first graded dirt race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! I was surprised too.
Total explosion of talent!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thanks♪
...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san!
Are you already done eating?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, I think this result was all thanks to Espo-sensei!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So! Could you please
continue coaching me!?
...At least just for the summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Huuuh~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't bow your head like that, Falco!
You got great results in the race, didn't you?!
...Stand tall and be proud!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, puff your chest out more!
...Ora! Ura!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yay☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that's not it!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because, while I'm happy you're praising me...
it's true that there was a weak Falco back then.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's "still not there yet," Espo-san.
I was weak—and that's why I came in 2nd.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That weakness, though...
is what will take me to the next stage.
Telling me, 'Next time, you'll definitely be able to win.'"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And that's how an Umadol moves forward!
To show everyone 'me at my absolute best'!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can train my weaknesses with all my might!
To aim for the top with everything I've got! To the absolute fullest!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What the hell?
Going on and on about how weak I am...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Don't get it at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, surely you must get it~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I haaaave nooo iiiideeeaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Admit to yourself first that you're weak!
—Otherwise, you won't ever get any stronger!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously, that makes no sense at all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You d-didn't have to go and call me weak!
Shut uuuup alreadyyyy—!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind teaching you, but still---!
Still... nghhhh~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...â
Kh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Wait—is that Furioso?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Pushing herself pretty damn hard.
And all on her own, too...)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, Furioso!
Perfect timing, let's run."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm lookin' to blast full speed ahead too.
So—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, hey... you bastard!
Where do you think you're going!?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*...! Damn it...
How much further can she go...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —What could their objective be?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Why call out to me so suddenly?
And going so far as to chase after me, too...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? T-That's, well!
...Gh, I was thinking of running for you――

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
it might be best to invite someone else.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Unlike you, I'm not a Central Umamusume.
I'm an exchange student from the regional circuit... from Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huuuuh~? You bastard...
You're at it again. Always obsessing over
whether it's the Central or the Local tracks...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: There are still many who look down on Funabashi as inferior to the JRA.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to overturn that somehow.
By winning as a special exchange student still affiliated with Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I know we can pull it off.
The day will surely come when we overturn the idea that "regional Umamusume are weak."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Just as I was able to win the GⅠ Teio Sho the other day.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi will always be second-rate...?
I refuse to accept that.
I won't ever stand for such an evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As the representative of Funabashi,
I am a strong Umamusume—one who will defeat you of the Central.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So strong.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am your greatest and strongest enemy.
Now and always, I will only push forward aiming to be just that.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Well then—excuse me.

While cooling off in the night breeze and pondering what lies ahead—
a familiar Umamusume returned to the training camp lodge.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'm gonna keep charging forward at full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Like hell I'll let anyone see even a millimeter of weakness!
I'm strong. ...I AM strong!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(So this is fine!
I mean, there've been other folks like that too, right?!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Let's go for the win in the Mile Championship Nambu Hai!
That's our next goal, right?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, no changes to that plan.
Yeah, there's no change to that plan.

text_block_list.text:
Espoir City feels that, thanks to the effects of
'The Strongest Umamusume's Training,'
she herself is strong now... That's how she sees it.
"That is precisely why this single battle is a perilous gamble. If I were to lose—"
choice_data_list: (...The effect of the "lie" will wear off.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely taking 1st place.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll show you my strength!

—Take 1st place in the "Mile CS Nambu Hai."
Let us give her a result that lets her truly believe, "I am strong."

"I'm just a weak Umamusume"...
I won't let her backslide like that.
